gloss: light and clean; light and dry (of sake)

definitions.gloss: light and clean; crisp and dry
definitions.explanation: Describes sake or other beverages that have a clean, light flavor without heaviness or strong sweetness. A key term in sake classification.
Describes something with a clean, delicate beauty. A literary usage applied to appearance, scenery, or artistic works.

notes:
A compound of {淡|たん} (light, pale) and {麗|れい} (beautiful, elegant). The two characters together suggest something that is beautiful in its lightness and purity.

USAGE:
Sense 1 (sake) is by far the most common modern usage. Japanese sake is often classified along two axes: {淡麗|たんれい} vs. {濃醇|のうじゅん} (rich, full-bodied) and ⟦{辛口|からくち}→辛口：18794_karakuchi⟧ (dry) vs. ⟦{甘口|あまくち}→甘口：18197_amakuchi⟧ (sweet). {淡麗|たんれい}⟦{辛口|からくち}→辛口：18794_karakuchi⟧ (light and dry) is the most popular style, especially from ⟦{新潟|にいがた}→新潟：27452_niigata⟧ prefecture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {淡麗|たんれい}⟦{辛口|からくち}→辛口：18794_karakuchi⟧ — light and dry (sake style)
- {淡麗|たんれい}な⟦{味|あじ}わい→味わい：11899_ajiwai⟧ — clean, light flavor
- {淡麗|たんれい}な⟦{容姿|ようし}→容姿：12293_youshi⟧ — delicate, refined appearance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{端麗|たんれい}→端麗：18941_tanrei⟧ — handsome, beautiful; a homophone that focuses on well-proportioned beauty
- {濃醇|のうじゅん} — rich and full-bodied (sake); the opposite in sake classification
- ⟦{上品|じょうひん}→上品：03081_jouhin⟧ — elegant, refined; a more general term for refinement
